title: Sparse Attention Serving for Long-Context Language Models
abstract: We study efficient serving of long-context language models with sparse attention. A chunked KV-cache scheduler keeps memory bounded while preserving answer quality on long-document benchmarks. Serving throughput improves 2.1x against dense baselines.

title: Quantized LoRA Fine-Tuning Under a Fixed Memory Budget
abstract: We fine-tune language models with 4-bit quantized LoRA adapters under a strict memory budget. A budget-aware rank scheduler trades adapter rank against quantization error. Quality matches full fine-tuning on three instruction datasets.

title: Speculative Decoding with Draft Models for On-Device Inference
abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates on-device inference by verifying draft tokens in parallel. We characterize when small draft models preserve output equivalence. Latency drops 1.8x on mobile hardware without quality loss.

title: Foundation Models for Abdominal CT Organ Segmentation
abstract: We evaluate foundation models for abdominal CT organ segmentation across eight hospitals. Parameter-efficient adaptation reaches specialist-level Dice on five organs. Domain shift between vendors remains the main failure mode.

title: Cross-Vendor MRI Harmonization with Style Priors
abstract: MRI scans vary across vendors and sites, which harms downstream models. We learn style priors that harmonize scans while preserving pathology. Harmonization improves lesion classification accuracy by 6 points.

title: Federated Learning for Multi-Institution Radiology Reports
abstract: We train report-generation models across institutions without sharing patient data. A federated aggregator with anatomy-aware weighting reduces site bias. Radiologists prefer generated reports in 61 percent of blind comparisons.
